conviction_note: Q3/2026 is confirmed for 10.11.2026 before the open. The quarter is not pre-released (no ad-hoc since the 4 May guidance raise), so the size is on the new-numbers plus possible-narrowing scale. Elmos's own observed results-day moves were +13.2%, +11.3%, +3.6% and -3.9%, so abs_move is 8.0. The evidence is balanced. On the negative side, FY consensus (662.6m, 6 analysts) sits at the very top of the 12% +/-2pp guide, there is no ad-hoc raise, H2 cash conversion must jump after Q2's 9.2% FCF margin, and the company itself describes wafer allocation. On the positive side, auto-semi peers printed healthy auto lines and the 30% drawdown since 6 Oct is pure sector beta. So p_up is 49 and the scaled number is near zero, matching the findings' sum of -0.5.

H1 2026: sales 314.5m (+15.4%), Q2 162.0m (+11.2%), Q2 operating EBIT margin 24.4%, Q2 operating adj. FCF 14.9m (9.2%), FY guidance confirmed
Wafer capacity agreements: SK keyfoundry 130nm long-term capacity through 2037 (9 Sep) and an extended Dortmund fab supply agreement 'in the current allocation environment' (17 Sep)

new_in_release.expect: Q3 sales near the 166m single-analyst bar (Q1 152.5, Q2 162.0, Q3 2025 comp 140.8 depressed by the SAP migration). Roughly in line, slight upside on peer auto strength, capped by wafer allocation.

Unknown, and the main line. Elmos narrowed its sales guide at Q3 2025. No ad-hoc has come since 4 May, so a raise above the 14% top is less likely than a confirmation or a narrowing. FY consensus of 662.6m already sits at the top, so a plain confirmation leans negative and a narrowing to the upper half is roughly neutral.
Q3 operating adj. FCF must recover from Q2's 9.2%. H2 needs about 20% of sales to reach the 19% FY midpoint, and capacity agreements may tie up working capital. Unknown sign.

IFRS 2 remeasurement of the cash-settled LTI liability. The share price fell from 180.4 (30 Jun) to 155.0 (30 Sep), so reported EBIT may come in above operating EBIT this quarter, the reverse of Q2's 12.1m charge. This is my inference and the liability size is not disclosed. Commentary on Q4, orders and 2027 could also appear.

findings.finding: FY2026 sales consensus of 662.6m (6 analysts) sits at the very top of the 12% +/-2pp guide (640.5-664.2m on FY2025's 582.6m), and Elmos, which uses a MAR ad-hoc for guidance raises (4 May), has filed none before Q3. A plain confirmation therefore reads as a soft guide against the bar.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Guidance raised by ad-hoc on 4 May 2026: +3.6% on 5 May. Guide merely confirmed with Q2 on 4 Aug 2026: -3.9% (dpa-AFX: 'Elmos schwach nach Zahlen'). Q3 2025 sales guide made more cautious yet free-cash-flow guide raised: +13.2% on 4 Nov 2025.

findings.why_not_priced: The gap between the quarterly bar (652.5m implied) and the FY bar (662.6m) shows the FY estimates were not refreshed down to the run-rate. If the market had priced a mere confirmation, FY consensus would sit near the 652m midpoint and not the top. The 30% fall since 6 Oct matches the sector (IFX -29%, STM -28%) and is not an estimate cut.
findings.independence: The guide and the ad-hoc precedent come from the company's own filings: https://www.eqs-news.com/news/ad-hoc/elmos-semiconductor-se-raises-guidance-for-fiscal-year-2026/9d90982b-f8ff-4d61-b045-635baf2e81ba_en. findings.finding: Auto-semi counterparties that reported after Elmos's last update printed healthy auto lines: NXP Q3 auto revenue +13% y/y (+17% ex the divested MEMS business), STMicro guided Q4 revenue +10.5% q/q, and Melexis landed inside its Q3 guide and confirmed its H2 guide.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 2026 sales landed exactly on the bar (162.0 vs 161.7) and the stock fell 3.9%. Q1 2026 was -0.8% vs the bar inside a guidance raise (+3.6%).
findings.why_not_priced: Only partly unpriced. ELG fell 8% on 22 Oct and 6% on 5 Nov with the sector on AI-valuation worries, not auto demand, so its price does not carry the auto read-through. If it did, ELG would have decoupled upward from IFX and STM after 27-29 Oct, and it did not.

findings.finding: Elmos itself describes a wafer 'allocation environment'. In May it warned of possible 8-inch wafer and service-provider capacity constraints from the AI boom, and in September it extended its Dortmund fab supply deal to 'secure additional wafer capacity in the current allocation environment'. Supply, not demand, may cap Q3/Q4 sales against a top-of-range FY bar.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No prior print where supply constraints were the line. Q2 2026's sequential slowdown ('schwächte sich das Wachstum ... ab') was sold, -3.9%.
findings.why_not_priced: The company published it as a positive strategic item, and the stock rose 9.4 EUR on the next sessions (18 to 22 Sep). If it had been read as a sales cap, the wire would have framed it as a constraint, and it did not.
findings.independence: Q1 release, 5 May 2026: 'partial capacity constraints regarding 8-inch wafers and manufacturing service providers cannot be ruled out in the coming months due to the ongoing AI boom'. https://www.eqs-news.com/news/corporate/elmos-semiconductor-se-impressive-start-to-year-2026-guidance-raised/87b0649a-52bf-4ba2-82fb-f118a7015be4_en (same issuer, a different document)

findings.finding: The FY operating adjusted FCF guide of 19% +/-2pp needs about 20% of sales in H2 (about 68m on about 338m) after H1 at 17.7% and Q2 at only 9.2% (14.9m). Q3 cash conversion is a live line the market has no number for, and the new capacity agreements could tie up working capital.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: FCF was the line that lifted the stock on 4 Nov 2025 (+13.2%, FCF guide raised, 'Freier Cashflow-Prognose ... erhöht') and drew the boerse.de headline 'Cashflow-Ziel wird honoriert'.
findings.why_not_priced: No estimate source carries a quarterly FCF bar (finanzen.net shows only sales and EPS). The working-capital link to the capacity agreements is my inference, not a disclosure, so this is sized small and signed only slightly negative. Q3 was seasonally strong for cash in 2025 (23.1%).
findings.independence: Q3 2025 seasonal cash strength, 32.5m or 23.1%: https://www.eqs-news.com/news/corporate/elmos-semiconductor-se-encouraging-order-development-and-strong-free-cash-flow-in-the-third-quarter-of-2025-free-cash-flow-guidance-for-the-full-year-increased/f1b8f7a8-abc6-4b39-921c-08c028c62062_en. findings.finding: The LTI plans have been cash-settled since Q2 and the IFRS 2 effects sit outside operating EBIT: Q2 reported EBIT was 27.5m against 39.6m operating while the share rose from 143.8 to 180.4. In Q3 the share fell from 180.4 to 155.0, so the liability remeasurement should flip to a gain, and reported EBIT/EPS may print above operating. That removes the headline 'profit down a quarter' that weighed on the Q2 day.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 2026: MWB Research said the IFRS 2 distortion 'could weigh on short-term sentiment'. Net income -23.5% y/y and the stock fell 3.9-5.1% on the day.
findings.why_not_priced: It is a mechanical accounting item that no estimate tracks: the single Q3 EPS estimate of 2.00 is on an operating-like basis, against reported Q2 EPS of 1.23. It sits below operating income with no path to the guide, so it gets only a fraction of the size. The liability size is undisclosed, so the sign of the gain is inferred, not confirmed.

baseline_tension: The findings net slightly negative (-0.5) against a mildly positive lean (+0.8, which is just the -16% run-up). The two positive findings are the ones that agree with that lean, so they were kept small. Neither side carries a company-level unpriced number, and both the scaled number and the sum sit near zero.
language_note: The issuer's German Finanzkalender (elmos.com/ueber-elmos/investor/kalender.html) gave the confirmed date, 'Quartalsergebnis Q3/2026 10.11.2026'; the English searches returned only vendor estimates, and one German aggregator (finanztrends) had a wrong 9 Nov date
finanzen.net's German FactSet page was the only source of the bar: quarterly 166m with 1 analyst against FY 662.6m with 6 analysts. That inconsistency is the core of the guidance finding

dpa-AFX via Der Aktionär and Börsen-Zeitung carried the Q2 reaction mechanics: the IFRS 2 distortion weighing on sentiment, 'Abwärtstrend seit Ende Juni', the stock -3.9 to -5.1% on the day. The English release did not frame it that way
German broker-sentiment pieces (goldesel) attributed the October sell-off to 'Sorgen um die KI-Entwicklung' across the sector; the English sources did not explain the drawdown
lessons_applied: 'The move is in the guide' plus 'too small about the move': abs_move_pct raised from 7.5 to 8.0. The quarter is new and a guidance narrowing at Q3 is plausible; Elmos's own results days moved 13.2, 11.3, 3.6 and 3.9%.
'Positioning is the thing to beat, not to agree with': the drawdown/de-rating finding cut from +0.4 to +0.2, because it agrees with the run-up lean.
'Cash can outweigh a raised guide' (Luceco): added a cash-flow finding (-0.3) from H1 numbers I already had. H2 needs about 20% FCF after Q2's 9.2%.
Bar unsourced or disputed, so findings capped: the guidance finding cut from -0.8 to -0.6, because the quarterly bar has one analyst and conflicts with the FY consensus.
'A narrow proxy loses to a broad series': the peer read-through cut from +0.5 to +0.4.
One-off below operating income sized at a fraction: the IFRS 2 remeasurement cut from +0.2 to +0.1.
p_up moved from 52 to 49 after the cash-flow finding and the trims to the positive findings.
